# GrowthBook X Ecco: Tool Intro for front end + Question time
Date: 2026-09-29 | Duration: 53.689998626708984m

## Summary
The team confirmed Nur Maulidiyah’s GrowthBook access and resolved her initial login issue. GrowthBook’s 6.9 KB JavaScript SDK, Next.js and React support, edge-network options, and proxy hosting were reviewed as alternatives to VWO’s 50 MB SDK. Experiments use feature flags or the Visual Editor and connect to data warehouses such as Postgres for live metrics. Targeting relies on SDK attributes including device type and country, while Dev Tools and environment scoping support QA; there is no direct preview mode like VWO. GA4 event tracking, sticky bucketing, fallback attributes, Bayesian and Frequentist analysis, configurable MDEs, CSV exports, and health monitoring were discussed. The AA test has about 2,100 anonymous IDs, balanced traffic, and no anomalies, but its data is limited to the Czech Republic. Nur will implement the Next.js SDK for AB testing while coordinating with Vitold to avoid disruption. Teams chat, regional engineers, documentation, and follow-up meetings will provide support.

## Keywords
GrowthBook, Feature Flags, SDK Integration, Visual Editor, Experimentation, Google Analytics

Implement GrowthBook SDK-based A/B test in backend after current AA test; coordinate with Vitold to avoid interference (45:30)

# GrowthBook x ECCO: Kickoff
Date: 2026-11-10 | Duration: 26.690000534057617m

## Summary
ECCO’s newly formed Experimentation and Personalization team is coordinating with the CRO, analytics, and front-end teams to establish website and CRM experimentation. GrowthBook was selected over the previous approach and VWO because it supports broader collaboration and avoids VWO testing limits; ECCO will use remaining VWO credits before switching. The company will use GrowthBook Cloud, with SSO planned, and position GrowthBook between Bloomreach CRM logic and website delivery. Production implementation will use the JavaScript SDK with React instead of GTM, following a Czech-market proof of concept that experienced occasional flickering. Noor and Thomas lead implementation, while Witold owns data connectivity and analytics. Snowflake connectivity has been validated, with Bloomreach, SAP, S360, Google Analytics, and BigQuery among the data sources. Metric and dimension modeling still require guidance. Code freezes and Black Friday campaigns limit production releases, so ECCO will continue local and test-environment work, aiming for validation in early December and potentially progressing from A/A to A/B testing. Technical onboarding, experimentation training, Teams integration, and SSO setup are planned.

## Keywords
GrowthBook, A/B testing, JavaScript SDK, Snowflake, Bloomreach, SSO
